lineagePage.title: Data Lineage
lineagePage.intro: Paste a query below and Provisa maps each result column back through its transforms and command calls to the original source columns, so you can see what feeds a column before you publish a view or command. Or choose Complete Lineage to see provenance across every registered view and dataset.
lineagePage.queryHelp: Any SELECT that reads your registered tables, views, or commands. It is analyzed and never run, so no data is read.
lineagePage.cycleError: (no materialization boundary: likely a design error)
lineagePage.emptyBody: No lineage was found. Complete Lineage spans your registered views, and none are defined yet. Register a view (Derived → Views), or analyze a query above to see its lineage.
